title: PromptTemplate
description: Schema for all prompt templates in reasoning/prompts/. Every template file must validate against this schema.

id.description: Unique identifier for this prompt template. Used to look up the template at runtime.

version.description: Semantic version of this template. Changing this triggers a full golden test re-run.

module.description: The ReasoningModuleType enum value this template belongs to.

model_hint.description: Preferred Claude model ID. Defaults to the ANTHROPIC_MODEL env var if omitted. Changing requires full eval suite re-run.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens to request from Claude. Must not exceed 4096 for non-extended-output models.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Must be 0 for deterministic reasoning modules. Non-zero only for exploratory what-if analysis.

system.description: System prompt. Must NOT contain any compute logic or numerical derivations — those belong in the engine layer.

user_template.description: Jinja2 template for the user turn. Variables are compute outputs passed from the engine layer.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema describing the expected structured output from Claude. Used to validate ReasoningOutput.

review_required.description: If true, the ReasoningOutput.review_required flag is always set. Required=true for DISCLOSURES module.
